Kata.Arti_kata_en: and a bearer of glad tidings
should We compel you (to accept) it
and You have mercy on me
the one in whom hope was placed

Kata.Arti_kata_in: maka Kami sampaikan kabar gembira kepadanya
Kata.Arti_kata_en: Then We gave her glad tidings
as much as I am able
as much as I am able
surely we would have stoned you
will surely pay them in full
surely will pay them in full
